proves.claim: contribute check --issue N prints the same failures and returns the same exit code as the file form for the same record body, with a fake GitHub client and no network.

cli.io-commands-contribute.issue-matches.why: Without it, the issue form could drift from the file form and tell a contributor a different list of fixes.

proves.claim: A failed issue read is refused as ISSUE_READ naming the issue and a next step, with no stack trace.

cli.io-commands-contribute.issue-read-fa.why: Without it, a GitHub outage would show a contributor a raw error instead of what to do.
